page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor running at a base clock of 2.5 GHz, providing 12 physical cores and 24 vCPUs via two threads per core. The processor includes 35 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1 data cache per core. Compute instruction extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with AES hardware cryptographic acceleration. The instance does not include integrated GPUs, relying entirely on CPU compute capacity.

The configuration provides 48.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU typical of compute-optimized tiers. Networking is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, while integrated local storage is absent, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for file persistence. In synthetic memory testing, the architecture achieves 108.94 GB/sec for uncached large-block read operations and 47.99 GB/sec for large-block write operations, alongside a small-block cached read throughput of 1168.35 GB/sec.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent mid-tier compute capabilities across varied processing workloads. The instance achieved a multi-core Geekbench score of 8967.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 21643.62, while stress-ng multi-core reached 21007.3. However, single-thread performance is comparatively modest, with stress-ng single-core scoring 1313.3 and single-threaded gzip compression registering 22.86 GB/sec, placing it in the bottom 25% of evaluated systems. Parallelized tasks perform significantly better, evident in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 101.61 GB/sec and software compilation in Clang scoring 17481.0.

Given its 24-vCPU density and balanced compute profile, ecs.c6.6xlarge provides practical resource efficiency for horizontally parallel operations without the overhead of excess memory allocation. It is suited for workloads such as batch data processing, distributed compiling, continuous integration pipelines, web application servers, and microservice backends that rely on concurrent multi-core throughput.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores, 48.0 GB of system memory (2.0 GB per vCPU), and an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance features no local storage and does not include GPU acceleration. It supports instruction extensions such as AVX-512 and AES. Across multi-core benchmarks, the server delivers stable mid-tier performance, scoring 21643.62 in PassMark CPU and 8967.0 in Geekbench multi-core, while single-thread stress-ng scores reflect lower per-thread output. With its 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio, ecs.c6.6xlarge is well-matched for parallelized batch processing, continuous integration, software compilation, and scalable web backend services.
